content_en: Some team members assigned to a new technology project expressed their lack of knowledge about the technology and the challenges they will face during implementation. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Due to the project due dates, replace the members with more knowledgeable staff.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the team members to do some research and self-learning efforts about the technology.
option_3_content_en: C.Reallocate the members to work on and complete different tasks for which they have experience.
option_4_content_en: D.Reassure the team members that a training path is in place to learn the new technology.

content_en: In two months, there will be a delivery of project machines from a factory. The project team is in the process of performing a follow-up meeting to review the commitments and dependencies regarding these machines. Which actions should the project team take to ensure that the deliveries are properly performed by the factory? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.Ensure that they track and monitor all dependencies and report at regular intervals.
option_2_content_en: B.Send an email to the research and development factory one week before delivery.
option_3_content_en: C.Specify exactly when a dependency is required and for how long this requirement holds.
option_4_content_en: D.Schedule a meeting with the factory regarding how the machine is going to be manufactured.
option_5_content_en: E.Talk to the factory employees to ascertain if they are qualified to build the machines.

content_en: A project team recently completed a long-term project using a predictive approach. The team then started a new project with the same project manager, but now they are using an agile approach. After the initial sprint, the team waits for the project manager to make decisions on behalf of the team, as has been done in previous projects. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the product owner to make decisions for the team.
option_2_content_en: B.Give continuous positive feedback to all team members.
option_3_content_en: C.Remind the team that they are using an agile approach.
option_4_content_en: D.Coach the team to guide and support their own decisions.

content_en: A project manager is facing a delay in a project due to a decision made by the functional manager to provide onsite support for another project without consulting other parties impacted by this decision. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Check the impact of the delay on schedule and cost.
option_2_content_en: B.Share the work schedule with the functional manager.
option_3_content_en: C.Meet with stakeholders to agree on a communications management plan.
option_4_content_en: D.Inform the customer about the delay and set a new delivery date.

content_en: A project team has been tasked to build a new product. The team builds the demo first and add features to the initial product. This is an example of what technical practice?
option_1_content_en: A.Test-Driven Development (TDD)
option_2_content_en: B.Continuous Delivery
option_3_content_en: C.Behavior-Driven Development
option_4_content_en: D.Spikes

content_en: A company's project management office (PMO) is incorporating more adaptive technologies and has hired a new project manager with hybrid project management experience. The team is slow in adopting the new methodology and has not been updating project artifacts in a timely manner. Which action should the project manager take to improve the team's performance?
option_1_content_en: A.Send an email asking all project team members to complete updates at the end of the day.
option_2_content_en: B.Set up a training session for all project team members.
option_3_content_en: C.Reach out to the functional managers for support.
option_4_content_en: D.Speak individually with each project team member about making the needed updates.

content_en: A company has an existing contract to maintain and enhance a client's customer database. The company's legal department informs the project manager that a new piece of legislation requiring stricter protection of customer information might soon be signed into law. The law will require additional security features to be implemented into the database the project manager is maintaining. These features are not included in the scope of the current contract. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Seek the project sponsor's support to influence the client to amend the contract immediately.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the legal department to raise the issue in the next contract negotiation with the customer.
option_3_content_en: C.Update the risk register with the issue and plan risk response with the project sponsor and client.
option_4_content_en: D.Wait until the legal requirements are finalized so the change in scope can be concretely defined.

content_en: A newly formed team has become accustomed to agile practices. The project lead has noticed that while they are performing according to expectations, there is boredom with daily team practices among many of the team members. What should the project lead do in this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Allow the team to self-organize and have them analyze the situation in their retrospective session and self correct.
option_2_content_en: B.Challenge the team to find new ways to achieve higher levels of performance to improve the situation.
option_3_content_en: C.Speak with individual team members to determine what they would like to do to improve the situation in the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Have the team inform senior management of the situation and ask for recommendations.

content_en: A team member is hosting an event and invites several colleagues through their work calendars. Another team member, who was not invited to the event, is noticeably distracted during several standup meetings. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the individual who is hosting the event to mark it as private.
option_2_content_en: B.Set up a meeting with the distracted team member to discuss any issues.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the individual who is hosting the event to use private communication methods.
option_4_content_en: D.Add a social events section to the charter to handle these situations.

content_en: An agile project is running its fifth iteration out of 10. After the last retrospective, the team members realize that they had to work extra hours to deliver the committed work. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team to have a lower commitment for the next iteration.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask for additional team members to maintain the velocity.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct a focused retrospective to help the team to discover the root cause.
option_4_content_en: D.Implement a checkpoint in the iteration to verify if the team is on track.

content_en: A product team is using a prototyping approach to deliver a multiyear business initiative. The project manager notices that a few user stories are taking longer to be delivered. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Review the project timeline and reallocate resources.
option_2_content_en: B.Conduct a retrospective with the team to identify bottlenecks.
option_3_content_en: C.Escalate the issue to senior management for intervention.
option_4_content_en: D.Modify the project scope to remove the delayed user stories.

content_en: Due to a recent incident, a dissatisfied stakeholder files a complaint about a project that has been closed. What can the project manager do to help resolve this?
option_1_content_en: A.Execute the relationship management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Consult with the project sponsor to manage the dissatisfied stakeholder.
option_3_content_en: C.Review the project management information system (PMIS) archives.
option_4_content_en: D.Update the risk register.

content_en: During a project steering committee meeting, the project manager reports that a formerly supportive key team member has become resistant to and negative about changes. Where should this information be captured?
option_1_content_en: A.Responsible, accountable, consult, and inform (RACI) matrix
option_2_content_en: B.Stakeholders engagement assessment matrix
option_3_content_en: C.Risk register and issue log
option_4_content_en: D.Work performance reports

content_en: A team receives outsourced deliverables and determines that they do not meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria. What should the project manager reference to verify this with the vendor?
option_1_content_en: A.Procurement management plan
option_2_content_en: B.Request for proposal (RFP)
option_3_content_en: C.Statement of work (SOW)
option_4_content_en: D.Inspections

content_en: A project to create a new product is completed and introduced into the market, but sales are much lower than expected. Analysis determines that the product is misaligned with the organization's core competencies. During what activity should this have been discovered?
option_1_content_en: A.What-if scenario analysis
option_2_content_en: B.Business case review
option_3_content_en: C.Strategic performance evaluation
option_4_content_en: D.Scope definition

content_en: While working on a project, the project team realizes that recent data center upgrades could impact the project's outcome. Certain modules of the project deliverable are incompatible with the new environment. The team identifies the appropriate steps to address the issue. What is the next step for the project manager?
option_1_content_en: A.Request a budget increase.
option_2_content_en: B.Submit a change request.
option_3_content_en: C.Change the project schedule.
option_4_content_en: D.Update the requirements document.

content_en: A company is using Lean Six Sigma methodology on a project. Midway through the project, an external Lean consultant is invited to conduct an audit to ensure that the methodology is being properly applied. Which process is being employed?
option_1_content_en: A.Manage Quality
option_2_content_en: B.Control Quality
option_3_content_en: C.Perform Qualitative Risk Analysis
option_4_content_en: D.Plan Quality Management

content_en: An experienced project manager is preparing a kick-off meeting for a new service assessment. A high-level description of the service has been provided. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Develop the project charter.
option_2_content_en: B.Develop the responsible, accountable, consult, and inform (RACI) matrix.
option_3_content_en: C.Define the project scope statement.
option_4_content_en: D.Create the work breakdown structure (WBS).

content_en: During project execution, a project manager learns that a team member's functional manager wants to remove them from a project because they believe they should not execute a certain task due to conflicting priorities. What should the project manager do first?What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Check the responsibility assignment matrix (RAM).
option_2_content_en: B.Check the work breakdown structure (WBS).
option_3_content_en: C.Check the organizational chart.
option_4_content_en: D.Check the resource management plan.

content_en: A project manager discovers a significant flaw in a major project deliverable. Which project management process is being performed?
option_1_content_en: A.Manage Quality
option_2_content_en: B.Control Quality
option_3_content_en: C.Plan Quality Management
option_4_content_en: D.Statistical Sampling

content_en: All quality controls have passed, and a project deliverable is ready to be released to the customer. However, a change request to add new quality criteria has been approved. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Update the project management plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Stop the release of the deliverable to the customer.
option_3_content_en: C.Use the new quality criteria for future deliverables.
option_4_content_en: D.Update the risk register.

content_en: A multinational company is locally developing a digital product using a new technology platform. The only expert on this platform is located in the company's headquarters, and they are responsible for providing support to different countries. How can the local project manager ensure the involvement of this expert?
option_1_content_en: A.Design a travel schedule so that timely, onsite assistance can be provided.
option_2_content_en: B.Include the expert on the team using a virtual environment.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the project sponsor to assign the expert as a full-time member of the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask team members to contact the expert as an external expertise source on an as-needed basis.

content_en: During project closure, the project manager finds it difficult to obtain successful project completion feedback. Some stakeholders disagree with the project's success criteria and have been frustrated with the project from the beginning. To what should the project manager refer to address these concerns?
option_1_content_en: A.Project charter
option_2_content_en: B.Quality management plan
option_3_content_en: C.Scope statement
option_4_content_en: D.Requirements documentation

content_en: An impact assessment reveals that a deliverable could be delayed by two weeks. A key resource has not been available to work on a non-critical activity due to other priorities. This could cause work overload on the other remaining resources. Since cost is a major constraint for this project, what should the project manager do immediately?
option_1_content_en: A.Determine if the task has available float to meet the project end date.
option_2_content_en: B.Hire a temporary resource to do the job.
option_3_content_en: C.Consult the team and reduce the scope.
option_4_content_en: D.Change the resource calendar to avoid major delays.

content_en: An approved project charter stated that an agile approach must be used. During a lessons learned session, the client indicates that the team was unable to provide reliable cost estimates for the project, and that more time should be allocated to define the scope during the first iteration. What lesson should be captured in the lessons learned repository?
option_1_content_en: A.The client should be exposed to the agile approach in advance to understand the cost estimating process.
option_2_content_en: B.The agile approach should not be used if the client requires reliable cost estimates.
option_3_content_en: C.During the first iteration of a project, time should be allocated to define the scope and ensure that reliable cost estimates are performed.
option_4_content_en: D.Client communications should be included in the daily standups.

content_en: A senior manager informs a project manager that the project is not performing as well as other projects. What can the project manager use to improve performance for the next series of iterations?
option_1_content_en: A.Retrospective session
option_2_content_en: B.Backlog analysis
option_3_content_en: C.Team building
option_4_content_en: D.Team motivation

content_en: A company is kicking off a new hybrid project to be in compliance with new government regulations. The team has established a reliable velocity of 40 story points per iteration. Every iteration lasts 2 weeks. The sponsor wants to know when the project will be done if there are 800 story points remaining.
option_1_content_en: A.4 hours
option_2_content_en: B.8 weeks
option_3_content_en: C.40 days
option_4_content_en: D.10 months

content_en: A project manager was just given a new project to handle. She is working on the project documents and, after reading the Project Charter, is compiling the risks as she sees them. Once she completes the list, when should it be reviewed?
option_1_content_en: A.When starting the project and as each risk is closed.
option_2_content_en: B.While organizing, preparing, and carrying out the work.
option_3_content_en: C.During weekly meetings as new risks are identified and added.
option_4_content_en: D.Regularly and throughout the project.

content_en: At which stage in the Tuckman team development model should the project manager put the most focus on increasing team motivation?
option_1_content_en: A.Forming
option_2_content_en: B.Storming
option_3_content_en: C.Norming
option_4_content_en: D.Performing

content_en: An executive stakeholder has crucial decision power on the execution and success of a project. How should this stakeholder's importance be reflected in the stakeholder engagement plan?
option_1_content_en: A.Describe the executive's support level, expectations, risk threshold, and appropriate communications for various project needs.
option_2_content_en: B.Rank the executive in an organizational chart and illustrate any affinities or hostilities with other stakeholders.
option_3_content_en: C.Label the executive as "supportive" and ensure that email, phone numbers, and absence/vacation times are up to date.
option_4_content_en: D.Describe the executive's involvement in similar past projects in order to decide the appropriate engagement level on a case-by-case basis.

content_en: A project team has identified a number of defects with some deliverables and intends to resolve these as soon as possible. The project manager will need to submit a change request to the change control board (CCB). What should the project manager do before the request is submitted?
option_1_content_en: A.Implement the changes immediately due to time constraints.
option_2_content_en: B.Send the change request to the client for approval.
option_3_content_en: C.Complete an impact analysis of each requested change.
option_4_content_en: D.Send the change requests to the sponsor for approval.

content_en: A project team uses the Internal Rate of Return (IRR) occasionally to select the project projected to be most beneficial to the company. On one such occasion the IRR figures for the four projects were: Project A = 5%, Project B = 0%, Project C = 3% , Project D = 10%. Which of these projects should be selected based on these IRR figures provided?
option_1_content_en: A.Project A
option_2_content_en: B.Project B
option_3_content_en: C.Project C
option_4_content_en: D.Project D

content_en: project manager participates in a focus group that implements project management changes across the organization. The goal is to improve project effectiveness and success. Which process should the project manager suggest for lasting and successful change within projects?
option_1_content_en: A.Conduct individualized skills assessments and provide targeted training for each team member.
option_2_content_en: B.Monitor external regulations and adapt project management practices accordingly.
option_3_content_en: C.Faciliate open communication and build buy-in from all project stakeholders.
option_4_content_en: D.Implement a project management change management plan aligned with industry best practices.

content_en: When managing a strategic project for their organization, what four tools should a project manager use for risk analysis? (Choose four)
option_1_content_en: A.Brainstorming
option_2_content_en: B.Inspection
option_3_content_en: C.Risk checklists
option_4_content_en: D.Product evaluation

content_en: The project team members are dispersed across different countries. Suddenly, travel restrictions do not allow team members to collocate. When analyzing project risks, which risk analysis tools should the project manager use? (Choose two).
option_1_content_en: A.Risk checklist
option_2_content_en: B.Context diagram
option_3_content_en: C.Meetings
option_4_content_en: D.Data representation

content_en: During a team meeting, team members asked the project manager to advise them on project dependencies. What should the project manager ask the team to do for internal dependencies?
option_1_content_en: A.Become familiar with the latest organizational changes.
option_2_content_en: B.Read about the merger with a competing organization.
option_3_content_en: C.Check the changes related to the work-from-home policy.
option_4_content_en: D.Become familiar with the upgrade of the Internet provider.

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex project with many stakeholders that have conflicting priorities. Senior management asked the project manager to avoid "noise" because this is a highly political project. The project manager opted to use expert opinion from well known industry profiles. What did the project manager do to satisfy senior management's request?
option_1_content_en: A.Responded in a friendly manner to senior management
option_2_content_en: B.Appeared to be consistent in the use of words and actions
option_3_content_en: C.Cooperated with senior management to achieve mutual goals
option_4_content_en: D.Took action based on the senior management's power to act

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex, political project with many stakeholders having conflicting priorities. Senior management asked the project manager to ensure that there was no "noise" regarding the project. During a stakeholder meeting, the project manager asked a series of questions to confirm acceptance for each deliverable before asking for acceptance of the whole project. What did the project manager do to satisfy stakeholders?
option_1_content_en: A.Responded to positive actions of the stakeholders to reward actions
option_2_content_en: B.Acted in a manner that was consistent in the use of words and actions
option_3_content_en: C.Engaged with stakeholders by cooperating toward mutual goals
option_4_content_en: D.Acted based on the power authorized by senior management

content_en: A project manager is working with a team to develop work packages. The project manager noticed a gap in the requirements gathering where important points were missing, which would impact the project timeline. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Meet with the project sponsor to discuss canceling the project.
option_2_content_en: B.Meet with the project sponsor and stakeholders to request a budget increase.
option_3_content_en: C.Meet with the product manager to create a backlog with the missing requirements.
option_4_content_en: D.Evaluate the impact, update the risk register, and present it to the stakeholders.

content_en: A project manager planning a strategic predictive project has suddenly fallen ill. The project baseline must be submitted to the customer within 3 days, and the project management office (PMO) director must find someone to finish the planning. The choices are: Project manager A: highly experienced in Scrum projects only, available immediately for 2 days only. Project manager B: moderately experienced mainly in construction projects, available the next day for 1 week. Which project manager should the PMO director choose and on what basis?
option_1_content_en: A.A is available immediately and has more experience to plan quickly and correctly.
option_2_content_en: B.B better understands the complexities of predictive planning and has use of a network of subject matter experts (SMEs).
option_3_content_en: C.A is more up to date and conversant with the latest project planning trends and methodologies.
option_4_content_en: D.B will be available to work for a longer period in case the submission deadline is missed.

content_en: A project manager has engaged the sponsor and discussed concerns regarding noncompliance. The project manager understands that this could be a potential audit situation. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Do nothing and continue to work as before, assuming there will be an audit.
option_2_content_en: B.Disengage the noncompliant department, as this is problematic.
option_3_content_en: C.Disclose the source of the problem to the auditors and let them decide.
option_4_content_en: D.Gain the commitment and approval from leadership on noncompliance.

content_en: A project manager has made compliance-related changes by adopting a new project delivery approach. During external validation, an audit revealed that some of the component work did not conform to the organization's standards. What should the project manager have done?
option_1_content_en: A.Executed only compliant deliverables.
option_2_content_en: B.Clarified interpretation of compliance guidelines.
option_3_content_en: C.Translated business requirements to design.
option_4_content_en: D.Researched regulations in the public sector.

content_en: A project team recently experienced delays due to noncompliance which have made the project schedule less flexible and increased risk to cost and poor quality. The team is brainstorming about ways to avoid this in future. What is most far-reaching implication for the organization if this noncompliance is not resolved?
option_1_content_en: A.Business survival and continuity
option_2_content_en: B.Unhappy clients or end users
option_3_content_en: C.Slower response to system
option_4_content_en: D.Fines and penalties

content_en: A project team decides to document new aspects of a regulation as additional elements in the work breakdown structure (WBS). Which of the following are potential downsides to this approach? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.Traceability improves but requirements will likely remain fragmented.
option_2_content_en: B.Traceability of requirements becomes more difficult at the project level.
option_3_content_en: C.Some of these requirements may not be completed as part of the project itself.
option_4_content_en: D.Regulatory requirements are not necessarily tied to the scope of the project.
option_5_content_en: E.Splitting the new items takes time and also requires effort to update the WBS.

content_en: A project manager considers compliance to be part of the organization's process assets. The project team, however, has decided to include compliance as inputs to the relevant processes rather than document these rules as requirements. What is the project manager's compliance responsibility?
option_1_content_en: A.Acts as coordinator for the resources and activities
option_2_content_en: B.Conducts audits for the compliance requirement
option_3_content_en: C.Performs risk analyses of compliance risks
option_4_content_en: D.Changes process assets of the organization

content_en: A large infrastructure organization is reviewing and standardizing project tools and techniques. Regarding the question “When should the decision be made to take corrective action?”, which process group can this question come from?
option_1_content_en: A.Initiating Process Group
option_2_content_en: B.Planning Process Group
option_3_content_en: C.Executing Process Group
option_4_content_en: D.Monitoring and Controlling Process Group

content_en: During a complex project, a stakeholder informs the project manager about a requirement and proposes to call a meeting to inform team members mid-sprint. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Schedule a meeting with the stakeholder and a team member.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the stakeholder to explain and implement the requirements immediately.
option_3_content_en: C.Host a meeting with all team members to discuss the requirements.
option_4_content_en: D.Request the product owner add to the product backlog to be treated in the next iteration.

content_en: A product owner has requested to incorporate embedded functionality for the patient portal in the next sprint. The team decided to perform an Affinity Estimation session to define how much value will be delivered. Which role is responsible to facilitate the session?
option_1_content_en: A.Product Owner
option_2_content_en: B.Scrum Master
option_3_content_en: C.Developer
option_4_content_en: D.Stakeholder

content_en: Project managers must be able to identify flaws that cause errors in decision making. Which option would help a project manager make optimal decisions?
option_1_content_en: A.Utilizing biases
option_2_content_en: B.Using false assumptions
option_3_content_en: C.Checking with others
option_4_content_en: D.Applying logical errors

content_en: A project manager is working on requirement management in a pharmaceutical company. Which improvement is something the project manager's organization should expect as an outcome of the project?
option_1_content_en: A.Reduced quality
option_2_content_en: B.Increased costs
option_3_content_en: C.Reduced risks
option_4_content_en: D.Increased schedule

content_en: Project manager B has been assigned to take over a project from Project Manager A. Project Manager A informs Project Manager B that the project is on schedule, only because Project Manager A constantly pushes the team to perform. What is the first action Project Manager B should take as the new project manager?
option_1_content_en: A.Check the risk status.
option_2_content_en: B.Check the cost performance.
option_3_content_en: C.Determine a management strategy.
option_4_content_en: D.Tell the team the new objectives.

content_en: The project manager of an AI project leads with grace and confidence. They provide support, listen attentively, and allow their team members to work under little supervision. What model of worker behavior does the project manager exhibit?
option_1_content_en: A.Expectancy theory
option_2_content_en: B.Theory X
option_3_content_en: C.Theory Y
option_4_content_en: D.Theory Z

content_en: Which is an essential component for maintaining the support and commitment of all stakeholders?
option_1_content_en: A.Honesty
option_2_content_en: B.Effective communication
option_3_content_en: C.Transparency
option_4_content_en: D.Reliability

content_en: Which of the following is a tactic that a project manager can employ to effectively monitor the impact of the risk on the project while monitoring risks?
option_1_content_en: A.Risk avoidance
option_2_content_en: B.Risk escalation
option_3_content_en: C.Risk acceptance
option_4_content_en: D.Risk reporting

content_en: A project manager's team has identified the lack of proper knowledge transfer expectations in the project. Which of the obstacles does not apply in this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.A systematic review of the completed project
option_2_content_en: B.Personally handled failures and mistakes
option_3_content_en: C.Insufficient individual motivation to document the lessons learned
option_4_content_en: D.Sparse leadership involvement to promote knowledge transfer

content_en: A project manager is leading an agile project. For iterations one through five, the team’s velocity chart displays 18 story points, 30 story points, 22 story points, 23 story points, and 22 story points. What does this information demonstrate about the team's performance?
option_1_content_en: A.The team is not following agile practices properly.
option_2_content_en: B.The team's velocity is stabilizing over time.
option_3_content_en: C.The team is lagging behind as per the schedule.
option_4_content_en: D.The team needs to change their agile methodology.

content_en: A project manager is leading an agile project. The product owner complains that the project team is constantly completing fewer story points than the Scrum team working on another project. What should the project manager do to address this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the team to address this issue as part of the retrospective to improve their velocity in the next sprint.
option_2_content_en: B.Tell the product owner that it is incorrect to compare velocity across teams because story points are specific to each team.
option_3_content_en: C.Get approval from the product owner to add a contingency buffer to the sprint, and change the duration to increase velocity.
option_4_content_en: D.Take full responsibility for the team’s low performance as compared to the other team and apologize.

content_en: During an important project, one of the contractors complains that the approval process is difficult to handle and may delay the project schedule. What should the project manager do first?
option_1_content_en: A.Hire additional resources for the team to mitigate this risk.
option_2_content_en: B.Discuss with the team to find options to mitigate the risk.
option_3_content_en: C.Escalate the risk to upper management as critical for timely delivery.
option_4_content_en: D.Add the risk to the risk register to be monitored and reviewed.

content_en: A project manager is managing a project involving a few vendors. The project sponsor asks how the project will acquire goods and external services. Where should this information be documented?
option_1_content_en: A.In the Procurement Management Plan
option_2_content_en: B.In the Master Service Agreement
option_3_content_en: C.In the Bill of Materials Contract
option_4_content_en: D.In the Service Level Agreement

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex project that has a very high environmental impact. The project was approved by the organization's PMO and is now in the planning phase. The project sponsor provided the project manager with a list of all project stakeholders. What will be the next activity in the Stakeholder Management Plan?
option_1_content_en: A.Analyze
option_2_content_en: B.Monitor
option_3_content_en: C.Engage
option_4_content_en: D.Identify

content_en: A project manager is managing an agile project. The PMO manager is not familiar with agile delivery. Which of the following statements describe the agile approach?
option_1_content_en: A.Responding to change over following a plan
option_2_content_en: B.Customer collaboration over following a plan
option_3_content_en: C.Responding to change over processes and tools
option_4_content_en: D.Customer collaboration over comprehensive testing

content_en: A project manager has just completed the initiation phase of a project and needs to identify and analyze the stakeholders. The project charter focused on scope and budget approval only. What should the project manager do to identify stakeholders?
option_1_content_en: A.Review lessons learned from previous projects.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the project charter.
option_3_content_en: C.Conduct a brainstorming session with the project team.
option_4_content_en: D.Review the organization chart.

content_en: A project manager recently joined a new organization. The project sponsor is a subject matter expert and wants to manage scope by delivering in small increments and changing the scope based on feedback. Which of the following approaches should be the recommended option?
option_1_content_en: A.Scrum
option_2_content_en: B.Waterfall
option_3_content_en: C.Kanban
option_4_content_en: D.Predictive

content_en: You are the project manager in an organization that is implementing agile delivery. You have experience as a scrum master and will perform this role in addition to the project management responsibilities. One of the team members wants to know what the main focus of a servant leader is. What will be your response?
option_1_content_en: A.Client satisfaction and value delivered demonstration.
option_2_content_en: B.Growth and well-being of people and communities they belong to.
option_3_content_en: C.Stakeholders expectation management and communication.
option_4_content_en: D.Productivity and efficiency to achieve commitments made.

content_en: What are the four team-building leadership styles?
option_1_content_en: A.Visionary, affiliative, coaching and participative
option_2_content_en: B.Visionary, affiliative, coaching and pace setting
option_3_content_en: C.Visionary, affiliative, coaching and directive
option_4_content_en: D.Visionary, affiliative, coaching and high waters

content_en: A project manager wants to motivate their team members and improve project performance. Which approach is most likely to be effective?
option_1_content_en: A.Reward all team members equally with formal awards to publicly recognize their achievements.
option_2_content_en: B.Implement initiatives based on the project manager's understanding of what motivates others.
option_3_content_en: C.Delegate motivation to team members, assuming they are professionals who self-motivate.
option_4_content_en: D.Offer a diverse range of motivational incentives tailored to individual team member needs.

content_en: During the team meeting, two of the team members who worked on the same tasks are arguing about who is at fault for the task being late. None of them want to be perceived as the one who caused the delay. What is the most likely cause of this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Conflicting Priorities
option_2_content_en: B.Unclear Responsibilities
option_3_content_en: C.Personal Competition
option_4_content_en: D.Personnel Selection

content_en: After an organization trained and implemented a new mandatory project management software application for all project staff, the project manager noticed that several team members show low levels of commitment to the new software. What is the cause for this?
option_1_content_en: A.Fear of the unknown
option_2_content_en: B.Lack of required skills
option_3_content_en: C.Lack of clear project vision
option_4_content_en: D.Too much communication

content_en: A project manager is working on a long-term project in a complex environment. The project manager's focus is on maintaining healthy team work and collaboration. What conflict resolution strategy should be used within the project team?
option_1_content_en: A.Problem solving
option_2_content_en: B.Compromising
option_3_content_en: C.Accommodating
option_4_content_en: D.Consultation

content_en: A team lead is assigned to an ongoing project. The team members have been working together for a while. How should the team lead start building relationships?
option_1_content_en: A.Distribute tasks and observe the quality of the deliverables.
option_2_content_en: B.Talk about personal preferences and make sure the team understands your approach.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask some team members to share information about other members to become familiar with the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask the team members directly about both personal and work-related matters.

content_en: A project manager wants to establish an incentive and rewards strategy for the project team. What approach should be taken?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask Human Resources department which incentives should be provided.
option_2_content_en: B.Check on budget availability in order to determine specific reward amounts.
option_3_content_en: C.Provide an opportunity for publicly presenting the outcomes.
option_4_content_en: D.Identify the specific needs for each team member to determine incentives.

content_en: Select three ways to improve and practice leadership skills. (Choose 3)
option_1_content_en: A.Engage the team in the project process.
option_2_content_en: B.Be actively involved in the project tasks.
option_3_content_en: C.Treat each team member the same way.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask for feedback and analyze the results.
option_5_content_en: E.Use democracy for all team decisions.

content_en: Which of the following steps gives special attention to the group decision making processes?
option_1_content_en: A.Problem Definition
option_2_content_en: B.Problem Solution Generation
option_3_content_en: C.Ideas to Action
option_4_content_en: D.Solution Action Planning

content_en: A project manager seeks to alleviate the IT department's workload while empowering the business to initiate new implementations and lay the groundwork for future solutions. How should the project manager facilitate this transition?
option_1_content_en: A.Enforce stringent IT governance policies centralized within the IT department, ensuring uniformity and control over all IT endeavors.
option_2_content_en: B.Mandate comprehensive IT project proposals to the IT department for assessment and approval before any project can commence.
option_3_content_en: C.Enable business units to use a simplified IT project management platform to initiate and monitor projects independently.
option_4_content_en: D.Collaborate with cross-functional IT business teams to jointly plan and execute IT projects, fostering cooperation between stakeholders.

content_en: A project manager is assessing two investment opportunities. Project A is expected to generate cash flows of $100,000 per year for five years, with an initial investment of $350,000. Project B is expected to generate cash flows of $80,000 per year for five years, with an initial investment of $250,000. The company's required rate of return is 10%. What is the Net Present Value (NPV) for each project, and which one should the project manager recommend?
option_1_content_en: A.The NPV for Project A is -$21,462.75, and for Project B is -$14,850.30. The project manager should recommend Project B because it has a lower NPV.
option_2_content_en: B.The NPV for Project A is $21,462.75, and for Project B is $14,850.30. The project manager should recommend neither project as their NPVs are similar.
option_3_content_en: C.The NPV for Project A is -$21,462.75, and for Project B is -$14,850.30. The project manager should recommend neither project as both have negative NPVs.
option_4_content_en: D.The NPV for Project A is $21,462.75, and for Project B is $14,850.30. The project manager should recommend Project A because it has a higher NPV.

content_en: One in two dispersed teams fails to reach objectives due to:
option_1_content_en: A.Inability to manage the distributed workforce
option_2_content_en: B.Conflict management
option_3_content_en: C.Team purpose identification
option_4_content_en: D.Distribution of power

content_en: A new project manager is attempting to enable shared leadership within their virtual team. Which of the following options should the project manager avoid?
option_1_content_en: A.Respect team members’ competencies
option_2_content_en: B.Loosen the reins and avoid the “responsibility trap”
option_3_content_en: C.Encourage leadership behaviors
option_4_content_en: D.Maintain a "natural distance" with the team

content_en: A project manager needs to ensure that the products of the organization meet certain government standards and regulations. The project manager's team is developing a business requirements document (BRD) to help in this regard. Which of the following statements are correct about compliance requirements? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.Compliance requirements are functional requirements and must be included in the BRD.
option_2_content_en: B.Compliance requirements are non-functional requirements and must be documented in the BRD.
option_3_content_en: C.Compliance requirements should be part of the project scope and should be managed by the project team.
option_4_content_en: D.Compliance requirements can be considered organization assets and do not need to be included in the BRD.
option_5_content_en: E.Compliance requirements can not be considered organization assets and must be included in the BRD.

content_en: A project manager is on a project that is part of a business transformation initiative impacting most of the 10,000 employees in the company. The scope of the project is the improvement of collaboration between teams by implementing a new cloud platform that will replace a 20-year-old communication tool. What will be the most critical success factor?
option_1_content_en: A.Good quality, go-live should have zero critical defects.
option_2_content_en: B.Good user interface developed by talented graphical artists
option_3_content_en: C.Good change management planning and execution
option_4_content_en: D.Good change control process with fast approvals

content_en: Project manager for a large government organization decides to save money by changing the local implementation partner, and is considering using offshore resources instead. What are the main risks associated with using offshore resources? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.Offshore resources may need more supervision due to time and cultural differences
option_2_content_en: B.Offshore resources may not have the same business domain knowledge as the previous vendor
option_3_content_en: C.Offshore resources may need more effort in planning and managing project budgets
option_4_content_en: D.Offshore resources may need longer onboarding due to geopolitical differences
option_5_content_en: E.Offshore resources may need detailed documentation due to time and cultural differences

content_en: A project manager has identified stakeholders for a software development project: the sales team will be the primary users of the new software application; the IT department will be responsible for deploying and maintaining the new software application; and the project sponsor is the executive who is responsible for approving the project and providing funding. The project manager is in the planning phase of the project, and must engage the stakeholders. What is the most important thing for the project manager to do to build shared understanding?
option_1_content_en: A.Hold a kick-off meeting with all stakeholders.
option_2_content_en: B.Create a stakeholder register and communication plan.
option_3_content_en: C.Identify the stakeholders' needs and expectations.
option_4_content_en: D.Document the stakeholders' concerns and risks.

content_en: A long-term agile project has just reached its midway mark and a new project manager is appointed to take over. Additional to the project manager, a current stakeholder was interchanged with another who has more experience regarding the projects’ technology. What next step should the project manager take?'
option_1_content_en: A.Discuss expectations from the stakeholder and revise the engagement plan accordingly.
option_2_content_en: B.Encourage the new stakeholder to convene with the product owner to review pertinent information.
option_3_content_en: C.Notify all stakeholders after revising the project plan with new contents added.
option_4_content_en: D.Hold all upcoming sprint review meetings with the new stakeholder in attendance and revise the project plan.

content_en: During a retrospective meeting, the project team confirmed that all deliverables were completed according to the specifications provided in the product backlog. However, the number of errors found during testing increased dramatically. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Meet with quality assurance specialists to clarify the issue and seek resolutions.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the risk management plan to determine the mitigation strategy.
option_3_content_en: C.Perform a Monte Carlo analysis to identify possible scenarios and actions.
option_4_content_en: D.Register the risk in the risk register and monitor it during the next iteration.

content_en: An application developer took a story card to work that read "Customer can pay using credit card". After the implementation, the functionality was rejected because the application could not accept foreign credit cards. What should the project manager have done to avoid this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Described the user story in more detail.
option_2_content_en: B.Scheduled the user story for the next iteration.
option_3_content_en: C.Performed iterative backlog grooming with the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Gathered more detailed requirement specifications from end users.

content_en: A customer requires knowing exactly the state of a product, the overall project, and the next steps planned for the next month each month. How should the project manager communicate with this customer?
option_1_content_en: A.Send a weekly status email, including a complete assessment of earned value.
option_2_content_en: B.Generate a monthly status report and include technical issues as an attachment.
option_3_content_en: C.Have a monthly call with the customer to summarize what happened recently and give a general review of the product.
option_4_content_en: D.Present the project progress in monthly increments with a formal validation and comprehensive understanding of the status.

content_en: The sponsor notified the product owner that the budget was approved for a project. However, any additional investment for the project would have to wait until the next fiscal year. The product owner is concerned that this will hold up the project. What should the product owner do?
option_1_content_en: A.Track the budget based on the release plan and show the value to the business.
option_2_content_en: B.Explain that the project is just starting and the budget will need to be adjusted.
option_3_content_en: C.Track the budget based on each sprint and remove nice-to-have deliverables.
option_4_content_en: D.Ensure that the project manager monitors every invoice from the project.

content_en: During release planning, a conflict arises between stakeholders regarding prioritizing certain needs, which is causing the development team to lose focus. To align all stakeholders and resolve this conflict, which conflict resolution technique should the project manager employ?
option_1_content_en: A.Forcing
option_2_content_en: B.Collaboration
option_3_content_en: C.Withdrawal
option_4_content_en: D.Smoothing

content_en: An agile team has been struggling to keep up with the planned pace, which is frequently resulting in sprint failures. What should the project manager do to help avoid this situation in the future?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask the project sponsor to approve overtime to compensate for the lack of performance while adjusting the plan.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the velocity of the team over the last several sprints and adjust the plan accordingly.
option_3_content_en: C.Replace junior team members with more experienced ones, and negotiate the project scope to compensate for the budget gap.
option_4_content_en: D.Switch to a Kanban approach to have better control on the planned pace by limiting work in progress.

content_en: A project manager is struggling to figure out the performance of the project teams in an agile environment. For the same scope of work, team A has calculated and delivered 100 story points and team B has calculated and delivered 125 story points. Which team is performing better?
option_1_content_en: A.Team A as they have calculated fewer story points than team B.
option_2_content_en: B.Team B as they have calculated more story points than team A.
option_3_content_en: C.The team that completes the most stories selected from the sprint backlog.
option_4_content_en: D.The team with the least amount of defects in their deliverables.

content_en: The steering committee has asked a project manager experienced in agile to provide an indication of the time remaining on a medium-sized project. What tools can be used to provide this information?
option_1_content_en: A.Analysis of the business requirements document
option_2_content_en: B.A release burndown chart
option_3_content_en: C.Story points for the remaining user stories
option_4_content_en: D.Surrogate measurements

content_en: A large corporation is transforming itself from a predictive to agile approach. A project team with knowledge of agile practices is experiencing significant conflicts with the executives regarding the processes to be followed. How should these conflicts be resolved?
option_1_content_en: A.Negotiate with the executives and agree on a process.
option_2_content_en: B.Train the executives on agile practices.
option_3_content_en: C.Include the executives in team retrospectives.
option_4_content_en: D.Request that the executives use agile practices.

content_en: A project manager is managing a hybrid project. A stakeholder has directly contacted a team member and has requested a change. Due to the request, the team member was distracted from their work, which caused a loss in productivity. What should the team member do?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform the stakeholder that the correct procedure for new requirements is to provide it directly to the project manager.
option_2_content_en: B.Inform the stakeholder that the correct procedure for new requirements is to provide it directly to the change control board (CCB).
option_3_content_en: C.Inform the scrum master regarding the stakeholder's request for a change and the impact this has had on productivity.
option_4_content_en: D.Inform the scrum master so that the change can be discussed directly with the stakeholder.

content_en: In an industrial plant, the owner has decided to add more capacity to the plant by installing a new machine and updating the software used in production. This capacity enlargement will occur while the plant is still functioning and producing. The software update will be accomplished using an agile approach in order to minimize risk. The machine procurement, installation, and integration will be accomplished using predictive approaches. What types of communications will the project manager have to design into the schedule management plan to ensure the project will be on schedule?
option_1_content_en: A.Weekly colocated meetings with the relevant stakeholders
option_2_content_en: B.Biweekly written status reports from the relevant stakeholders
option_3_content_en: C.Weekly one-on-one meetings with each of the relevant stakeholders
option_4_content_en: D.Biweekly conference calls with the relevant stakeholders

content_en: A project is being executed. The project's life cycle is defined as predictive; however, a major deliverable will be handed over incrementally to the customer. The assigned resources are experienced and reliable and are willing to make decisions that the project manager used to make after each incremental delivery on other projects. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform the team that although this is a hybrid environment, the project manager must still be responsible for making decisions.
option_2_content_en: B.Consult the product owner about letting the resources make decisions.
option_3_content_en: C.Support the decisions of the team and transfer the decision making responsibility to them.
option_4_content_en: D.Schedule a steering committee meeting and obtain their approval on the request.

content_en: A transportation company is transforming its operational processes and the main system this company uses to move freight. The scope statement is in place. An iterative delivery approach has been agreed by all stakeholders. What does the project manager need to do next to help the team understand the work that needs to be done?
option_1_content_en: A.Start working on the project management plan with work packages, a detailed schedule, and work assignments for team members.
option_2_content_en: B.Work directly with stakeholders on the work breakdown structure (WBS) and assign tasks with a required timeline for each team member to start the work.
option_3_content_en: C.Work with the team to decompose the scope into a WBS and work packages in order to create required deliverables and timelines.
option_4_content_en: D.Create the requirements management plan to outline how project requirements will be collected, analyzed, and documented, and then assign requirements to team members.

content_en: A lengthy, ongoing project exhausts a project team. Due to deadline issues, the project manager cannot extend the project schedule. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Review the project charter.
option_2_content_en: B.Provide more recognition to team members.
option_3_content_en: C.Discuss the situation with the team.
option_4_content_en: D.Request additional resources.

content_en: A project manager in a cross-functional organization needs to inform the department manager of the number and type of resources required, and the length of time they will be needed. What should the project manager use to present this resource information?
option_1_content_en: A.Resource assignments
option_2_content_en: B.Resource histogram
option_3_content_en: C.Responsibility assignment matrix (RAM)
option_4_content_en: D.Project organization chart

content_en: A project manager is leading a project that is being implemented simultaneously in two countries with an 11-hour time zone difference. The project manager needs to determine a mutually convenient time to provide stakeholders with information on the project's schedule, cost, and performance progress. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Use a world clock to identify a few potential times that work for all stakeholders.
option_2_content_en: B.Send a survey to stakeholders asking them for their availability during the week.
option_3_content_en: C.Schedule two separate meetings, one for stakeholders in each country.
option_4_content_en: D.Record the meeting and send it to stakeholders to watch on their own time.

content_en: A demanding project stakeholder insists that an additional feature be added to a project product without changing the scope, budget, or schedule. The project manager allows this feature to be included since it adds great value to the end product. However, the project manager discovers that adding this feature has lengthened the project schedule and increased project costs. Which process should the project manager have followed before including the additional product feature?
option_1_content_en: A.Change control
option_2_content_en: B.Schedule planning
option_3_content_en: C.Procurement planning
option_4_content_en: D.Quality audit

content_en: A project is being audited to ensure compliance with organizational policies. What process is being conducted?
option_1_content_en: A.Audit Schedule
option_2_content_en: B.Plan Quality Management
option_3_content_en: C.Control Quality
option_4_content_en: D.Manage Quality

content_en: A customer's requested design change is approved by the change control board (CCB). The project manager then discovers that the change will cause a three-month project delay. What should the project manager have done to avoid this?
option_1_content_en: A.Increased the authorized budget, and requested additional resources
option_2_content_en: B.Redefined the project scope to include the new design
option_3_content_en: C.Fast tracked and crashed the schedule
option_4_content_en: D.Thoroughly assessed the request in accordance with the risk management plan

content_en: During a project's initiation phase, the project manager reviews the business case and finds that information is incomplete. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Add an information gap to the risk register.
option_2_content_en: B.Review the project statement of work (SOW) to create the project charter.
option_3_content_en: C.Revise the business case to narrow the project scope and create the project charter.
option_4_content_en: D.Review the business case with the sponsoring organization to confirm that the project aligns with business needs.

content_en: During project implementation, an issue arises that requires the execution of the project's contingency plan, which will impact the project schedule. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Initiate a risk audit.
option_2_content_en: B.Issue a change request.
option_3_content_en: C.Review the cost impact.
option_4_content_en: D.Update the contingency plan.

content_en: While preparing a project charter for a new project, a project manager reviews lessons learned from previous projects. The lessons learned documents show frequent issues with low engagement levels and stakeholder misalignment on project objectives. What should the project manager do to avoid repetition of this issue in the new project?
option_1_content_en: A.Allow any stakeholder to join the change control board (CCB) at any time in the project.
option_2_content_en: B.Include all stakeholders in the responsibility assignment matrix (RAM) for acceptance of the deliverables.
option_3_content_en: C.Gather all the requirements provided by every individual stakeholder and include in the work breakdown structure (WBS).
option_4_content_en: D.Build a common understanding among stakeholders about key deliverables described in the approved project charter.

content_en: A new project has high uncertainty in the cost required for completion. What approach should the project manager use to determine the expected costs?
option_1_content_en: A.Analogous estimating
option_2_content_en: B.Statistical techniques estimating
option_3_content_en: C.Parametric estimating
option_4_content_en: D.Three-point estimating

content_en: During a group activity to identify an input to the Plan Procurement Management process, some participants disagree with the ranking of compliance-related items. What tool or technique should the project manager use to resolve this?
option_1_content_en: A.Affinity diagram
option_2_content_en: B.Multicriteria decision analysis
option_3_content_en: C.Nominal group technique
option_4_content_en: D.Brainstorming

content_en: A project manager is on a mega industrial project. The project team is distributed throughout six different countries and time zones. During a review meeting, it was noticed that important baselined milestone dates were missed. What is the most likely reason for the missed deadlines?
option_1_content_en: A.Lack of buy-in commitment
option_2_content_en: B.Poor team communication
option_3_content_en: C.Misunderstanding stakeholder expectations
option_4_content_en: D.Stakeholders' expectation is set too high

content_en: In an agile development environment, when should a risk analysis be performed?
option_1_content_en: A.Before the start of each iteration
option_2_content_en: B.During the daily standup meeting
option_3_content_en: C.In the retrospective meeting
option_4_content_en: D.After every scrum meeting

content_en: A project manager has noticed apparent interpersonal conflict between some team members during the initiation of a project. When should the project manager address this problem?
option_1_content_en: A.At the earliest time possible to prevent the conflict from escalating later in the project
option_2_content_en: B.Prior to every meeting by reminding the project team to be respectful with each other
option_3_content_en: C.Directly after an outburst or dispute between members to determine which member is right
option_4_content_en: D.At the end of the project to let the conflict de-escalate and record it in the lessons learned

content_en: A team is working on a complex and fast-changing new product development project. After a recent process evaluation, the team decides to add an agile toolkit to the predictive approach they are using. This addition is intended to improve the overall project delivery, success, and productivity. Which of the following describes how this change is intended to add value to the overall delivery, success, and productivity?
option_1_content_en: A.Use the agile toolkit to leverage the ability of agile methods to respond effectively to change, while maintaining the benefits of a predictive approach to project management.
option_2_content_en: B.Use the agile toolkit to replace all predictive methods with new agile methods, and by doing so, reduce poor productivity.
option_3_content_en: C.Use the agile toolkit to compare agile against predictive methods, then choose the best approach for future projects.
option_4_content_en: D.Use the agile toolkit and ask team members to choose between agile and predictive methods so that they will work more effectively and productively.

content_en: A project manager engaged in the delivery of a global project is in the process of recruiting a project team. After the team is formed, what should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Send a welcome email and host a team introductory event with the team members so they get to know each other.
option_2_content_en: B.Send a project management plan and charter to team members to familiarize them with project goals and procedures.
option_3_content_en: C.Arrange a meeting for team members to discuss any concerns regarding requirements and project scope.
option_4_content_en: D.Send the team members a survey to learn more about each member, share the results via email.

content_en: A pharmaceutical project in the initiation phase is likely to be impacted by new market regulations. Which stakeholder categories should the project manager assign to the relevant regulatory body?
option_1_content_en: A.External with high power/influence
option_2_content_en: B.Internal with high power/influence
option_3_content_en: C.Internal with antagonist/resistant support level
option_4_content_en: D.External with antagonist/resistant support level

content_en: After stakeholder data and information collection is complete, an analysis of the collected data begins. The power/interest scores are plotted for each stakeholder on a set of the axis to provide a visualization of stakeholder power and interest. There are three stakeholders that have low power and low interest. What are the actions for them?
option_1_content_en: A.They must be kept satisfied by ensuring their concerns and questions are addressed adequately.
option_2_content_en: B.They require minimal management effort.
option_3_content_en: C.They must be kept informed and updated on the project.
option_4_content_en: D.They must be kept satisfied, but also actively engaged with and consulted on the project.

content_en: A team member approaches the project manager immediately after the end of the project meeting about his need for help to complete a late-due-date task. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Ignore the team member's request, and ask for double the efforts to complete the task
option_2_content_en: B.Discuss the issue during the daily meeting, and decide the course of action with the team
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the team member to step out from the task and re-allocate the task to someone else
option_4_content_en: D.Ask a junior team member to help in the completion of the task on the due date

content_en: A company is considering adopting the agile methodology for future projects. The project manager is leading a discussion focused on the benefits associated with the agile methodology. Which of the following points should the project manager highlight?
option_1_content_en: A.Transparency is central, early and reliable delivery, methodology embraces change
option_2_content_en: B.Product based method, divides projects into valuable phases, focuses on business justification
option_3_content_en: C.Clear documentation exist, single point of responsibility, effective collaboration
option_4_content_en: D.No overtime if possible, face-to-face contact and constantly looking back to move forward

content_en: A project team just completed an environmental scan and have uncovered a lot of related hindrances that could potentially affect the project delivery negatively. The project manager is working with the team to understand the details of each identified hindrance and how the hindrances relate to each other, in order to understand the overall complexity of the project. This will enable the team to arrive at a plan that addresses the challenges identified. Which of the following techniques has the project manager used in this instance?
option_1_content_en: A.Pareto analysis
option_2_content_en: B.Critical analysis
option_3_content_en: C.Systems thinking
option_4_content_en: D.Total quality management

content_en: A project team has successfully completed a project. The same team and three new people start another project led by a new scrum master. How will the new scrum master lead?
option_1_content_en: A.High directive, high supportive
option_2_content_en: B.Low directive, high supportive
option_3_content_en: C.High directive, low supportive
option_4_content_en: D.Low directive, low supportive

content_en: What interpersonal skills do project managers or teams need to monitor stakeholder relationships, evaluate engagement strategies, and modify these approaches as needed?
option_1_content_en: A.Active listening, leadership, and cultural and political awareness
option_2_content_en: B.Coaching, decision-making, and cultural and political awareness
option_3_content_en: C.Active listening, team building, leadership, and networking
option_4_content_en: D.Networking, influencing, and cultural awareness

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex project. The project includes many stakeholders with conflicting priorities. Which two actions should the project manager take to be prepared for negotiations and gain support from all of the stakeholders? (Choose two)
option_1_content_en: A.Allow enough contingency to cope with scope changes.
option_2_content_en: B.Develop a good relationship with the project team.
option_3_content_en: C.Understand the politics and personal interests of the stakeholders.
option_4_content_en: D.Develop a good communications management plan.
option_5_content_en: E.Develop a good risk management plan.

content_en: A project manager is working on a complex project that has high interest from senior management. There are many stakeholders with competing priorities, which requires significant negotiation skills to overcome rising conflicts. Which two principles should the project manager follow when developing the negotiation strategy? (Choose two).
option_1_content_en: A.Separate the people from the problem.
option_2_content_en: B.Focus on political issues first.
option_3_content_en: C.Focus on management priorities.
option_4_content_en: D.Focus on interests, not positions.
option_5_content_en: E.Delegate the decisions to the team.

content_en: A project manager is leading a project that is vital to their organization and the local environmental and energy authority. During a team meeting to discuss project risks , the team raised a high risk that an important senior manager is not currently involved with project. What should the project manager do to mitigate this risk?
option_1_content_en: A.Implement regular status reporting.
option_2_content_en: B.Escalate this risk to senior management.
option_3_content_en: C.Develop a highly detailed project management plan
option_4_content_en: D.Invite the senior manager to daily project meetings.

content_en: A project team is working on a complex high-priority project. The project manager is informed that there is a superficial disagreement between a project sponsor and a project team member. This conflict could negatively impact the project timeline and must be resolved immediately. The team member desires to maintain a good relationship with the project sponsor and asks the project manager how they should approach the situation. What conflict resolution approach should the project manager suggest?
option_1_content_en: A.Collaborating
option_2_content_en: B.Accommodating
option_3_content_en: C.Compromising
option_4_content_en: D.Forcing

content_en: An educational institution raises a complaint after placing an order for a software module from a company using agile practices. The complaint claims that billing for payment of a partial delivery violates the Agile Manifesto if the customer was not involved in progress meetings. The customer's claim is supported by which of the Four Values of the Agile Manifesto?
option_1_content_en: A.Processes maintaining a constant pace indefinitely
option_2_content_en: B.Software delivery frequently and in short periods
option_3_content_en: C.Customer collaboration over contract negotiation
option_4_content_en: D.Working software as a primary measure of progress

content_en: A project vendor has informed a project manager that an outsourced project deliverable will be available 6 months later than the agreed project schedule. The vendor stated that they are focusing on other project deliverables with priority dependencies, and this particular deliverable had no stated dependencies. What should the project manager do to avoid schedule delays in future?
option_1_content_en: A.Monitor the dependencies and respond to challenges.
option_2_content_en: B.Ensure that all new dependencies are finish to start
option_3_content_en: C.Specify any dependencies if they exist.
option_4_content_en: D.Conduct a meeting to inform the customer.

content_en: A project manager is working on a new compliance project that is different from regular projects as it will involve multinational partners and several government departments. The project will result in the adoption of new standards and procedures. What must the project manager do from the onset?
option_1_content_en: A.Ensure that the business requirements are defined and met
option_2_content_en: B.Ensure solution design is available from the start of the project
option_3_content_en: C.Ensure execution and handover are done effectively
option_4_content_en: D.Ensure the interpretation of compliance guidance and validation

content_en: A complex construction project entails the meeting of several regulations throughout project execution. The project team is brainstorming how to implement an effective method to ensure compliance throughout the term of the project. Which compliance review process is suitable for this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Conduct a gated review throughout the project phases.
option_2_content_en: B.Review at the end of the project.
option_3_content_en: C.Review before the closure of the project.
option_4_content_en: D.Conduct an informal review only that is based on need.

content_en: A project manager is helping an organization transition from traditional methods to agile. The infrastructure, data warehousing, and enterprise architecture teams operate very differently than the application development teams. How should the project manager implement agile in this organization?
option_1_content_en: A.Ask every team in the organization to implement the same agile methodology so that a one-size-fits-all solution can provide consistency across all teams.
option_2_content_en: B.Tailor the implementation by deliberately adapting the approach to make it more suitable for the given environment and work at hand.
option_3_content_en: C.Force the top-down transition approach by asking the CEO to provide support for implementing agile in every team in the organization.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask one team to implement scrum as a pilot so that all other teams in the organization can also implement scrum by learning from this team.

content_en: A group of stakeholders at a financial institution are conducting a project closure review. Some of the stakeholders are concerned that the project deliverables do not satisfy the established closure criteria. What is the first thing that the project manager should do to address this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Assure the stakeholders that the project deliverables satisfy all established closure criteria.
option_2_content_en: B.Propose that the closure criteria be amended by removing the criteria that have not been met.
option_3_content_en: C.Take corrective measures by adapting the closure criteria and extending the project timeline.
option_4_content_en: D.Perform a thorough analysis to determine why the closure criteria have not been satisfied.

content_en: An operational support project is running smoothly, but a customer consistently complains about a lack of visibility into the quality of the support work. How should the project manager address this customer concern?
option_1_content_en: A.Prepare relevant reports, send them to the customer daily, and publish them in a shared folder for future review.
option_2_content_en: B.Request the customer to appoint a manager from their area to review day-to-day activities and agreements reached during all discussions.
option_3_content_en: C.Plan a recurring governance meeting with the customer to present progress and publish data in a shared folder for future review.
option_4_content_en: D.Inform the customer that every day after the most important discussions occur, one team member will oversee updating them.

content_en: During the planning of a project with incremental deliveries, the team realizes that they will need specific expertise for one of the deliverables towards the end of the project. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Enroll the team in training so they can be equipped with the needed expertise.
option_2_content_en: B.Request the availability of the needed resources with expertise from the project sponsor.
option_3_content_en: C.Ask the team members to acquire expertise through self-paced learning.
option_4_content_en: D.Define and share the work agreement with the team to coordinate activities to acquire expertise.

content_en: In the middle of a project incremental delivery, due to a change in the technology, a team member informed the project leader that due to a lack of knowledge in the technology the delivery will be delayed and suggests outsourcing services. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Inform the end user of the delay of the specific delivery due to the new technology
option_2_content_en: B.Search for an outsourcing service with the experience needed
option_3_content_en: C.Inform the sponsor of the delay and ask for their support and approval
option_4_content_en: D.Discuss the impact of the new technology with the team and decide action jointly

content_en: An agile coach is counseling a large software organization that has been using waterfall methodology and now plans to start using agile or hybrid methodology. What would be a project manager's suggestion?
option_1_content_en: A.Continue using waterfall, since hybrid does not fit with the organizational structure.
option_2_content_en: B.Start with agile and then move to hybrid, although agile takes time to implement.
option_3_content_en: C.Start using hybrid methodologies because waterfall knowledge is transferable.
option_4_content_en: D.Start using hybrid, the more appropriate methodology for software organizations.

content_en: A project manager is leading a team on a new development project. The team is made up of a diverse group of people with different personalities and work styles. The project manager is committed to creating a cohesive and productive team, so they decided to introduce the DISC behavior model to help team members understand each other better. Based on the DISC behavior model, which of the following characteristics best describes the Influence style?
option_1_content_en: A.Direct, result-oriented, and firm
option_2_content_en: B.Outgoing, enthusiastic, optimistic
option_3_content_en: C.Accommodating, patient, humble, tactful
option_4_content_en: D.Analytical, reserved, and precise

content_en: A project manager works for a global company and understands the importance of the requirement management plan. When should the requirement management plan be implemented?
option_1_content_en: A.At the start of the project
option_2_content_en: B.Prior to executing
option_3_content_en: C.After customer contract signature
option_4_content_en: D.During the planning phase

content_en: A project manager is assigned to a project that is already in progress because the original project manager left the organization unexpectedly. Unfortunately, the previous project manager did not adhere to the organization's knowledge transfer procedures prior to leaving the organization. What can the new project manager do to fill the knowledge gaps? (Choose 3)
option_1_content_en: A.Review the project documentation, including the project plan, requirements document, and risk register.
option_2_content_en: B.Proceed with the project as planned and engage in job shadowing activities.
