option_3_content_en: C.Meet with key stakeholders to understand their expectations and priorities.
option_4_content_en: D.Interview team members to learn about their areas of expertise and experience with the project.
option_5_content_en: E.Reach out to the previous project manager and request a comprehensive knowledge transfer.

content_en: In an agile environment, a project leader should always consider a time for open and free discussions between team members on how the team can increase their performance. Why is this practice important for the team?
option_1_content_en: A.Teams should take actions to continuously increase productivity
option_2_content_en: B.Teams should continuously experiment new ways of doing things
option_3_content_en: C.Teams should continuously seek to improve their processes
option_4_content_en: D.Teams should continuously push their members to work harder

content_en: A project manager is leading a project with a scope partially delivered by a vendor. The vendor's processes and tools differ from the project team's, which may pose a risk. How should the project manager mitigate this risk?
option_1_content_en: A.Coach the internal project team to use the vendor's processes and tools.
option_2_content_en: B.Train the vendor to use the same processes and tools as the internal team.
option_3_content_en: C.Develop a strategy to align the internal and vendor processes and tools.
option_4_content_en: D.Recommend engaging a new vendor that uses the internal processes and tools.

content_en: A project is in the execution phase. Equipment and devices must be transported from the vendor's warehouse to the project site through five towns. Which stakeholders should the project manager involve in planning and executing a safe transport? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.City councils
option_2_content_en: B.Project sponsor
option_3_content_en: C.Equipment installers
option_4_content_en: D.Equipment suppliers

content_en: A project requires the services of a specialized vendor to install a very complex and expensive piece of equipment. The project manager sent an email a week ago to a partner to request a specialist come on-site. Unfortunately, the vendor has not replied to confirm. What communication method was used in this case?
option_1_content_en: A.Pull
option_2_content_en: B.Interactive
option_3_content_en: C.Push
option_4_content_en: D.Interpersonal

content_en: A project manager is managing an agile project. A new team member, who has never worked in an agile team, joins the project. The new member asks the project manager to explain why an agile approach is used. What should the project manager's response be?
option_1_content_en: A.To eliminate the risk and increase the predictability and visibility
option_2_content_en: B.To deliver value faster and change the scope based on feedback
option_3_content_en: C.To reduce the costs and increase the quality of the end deliverables
option_4_content_en: D.To eliminate the need for documentation by delivering working products

content_en: After an annual staff review, discussing project management and soft skills knowledge, the company made a decision to train all staff members to face new challenges. The method to train all staff members will be on a website where all content, exams,  templates, and other organizational assets are available. What method is being used for training purposes?
option_1_content_en: A.Pull
option_2_content_en: B.Push
option_3_content_en: C.Interactive
option_4_content_en: D.Interpersonal

content_en: A project steering group has made a decision to change the vendor that will deliver a component of a project. Which of the following activities should be included in the handover? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.The old vendor should provide training for the new one and assist with the transition.
option_2_content_en: B.Both vendors should provide additional incentives for staff during the transition.
option_3_content_en: C.The new vendor should take over activities as per the existing project plan.
option_4_content_en: D.The new vendor should shadow the old vendor to ensure knowledge transfer.

content_en: A project manager is working on a large business transformation project. All of the build deliverables were signed off and the project manager is managing the transition to BAU (Business as Usual). Which of the following are important operational readiness considerations that the project manager needs to consider? (Choose 2).
option_1_content_en: A.A cheat sheet for core functionality is provided and self training is encouraged.
option_2_content_en: B.Formal training and access to documentation should be provided to all users.
option_3_content_en: C.Responsibility and accountability are formally handed over to operational teams.
option_4_content_en: D.The project team remains responsible for operational support during BAU.

content_en: While developing the stakeholder management plan for a large project, a project manager organizes a workshop to identify and assess stakeholder power and influence. Due to time constraints, the workshop can only be one day long. What should the project manager do to achieve this goal within the workshop timeframe?
option_1_content_en: A.Use a Power-Interest Matrix
option_2_content_en: B.Use Nominal Group Technique
option_3_content_en: C.Use a Stakeholder Cube Model
option_4_content_en: D.Use a Pareto Diagram

content_en: In the Project team meeting the team members are complaining of a drop in motivation and that they don't feel that their efforts are appreciated. You decided to build and present the team as a high performance team to the organization. Which of the following attributes of the organizational environment and managerial style will lead to a high performance team? Select 3
option_1_content_en: A.Personal Driving Forces.
option_2_content_en: B.Work Challenge Dividend.
option_3_content_en: C.Progressive Financial Rewards.
option_4_content_en: D.Stimulating Environment.

content_en: A project manager decided to involve a third party to manage project risk given that they had more experience than the current project team. What kind of response strategy did the project manager apply to address overall project risk?
option_1_content_en: A.Avoid
option_2_content_en: B.Exploit
option_3_content_en: C.Transfer
option_4_content_en: D.Reduce

content_en: An internal project has delivered its scope on time, within budget, and with the expected quality. The client was satisfied with the result and it enabled them to launch the new product to market. However, the product did not attract the expected interest and did not cover the investment made. The project team is aware of these results and it is impacting their morale to deliver the next project. How should the project manager handle this situation? Choose 2 answers.
option_1_content_en: A.Have a discussion with the team to explain that the product success is not a direct result of the project and it does not reflect their performance
option_2_content_en: B.Have a meeting with the business to make sure they understand the project met its objectives
option_3_content_en: C.No action is necessary, as the project manager is only responsible for the project deliverables.
option_4_content_en: D.Have a conversation with the business sponsor to validate the strategy for the new project based on this result.

content_en: What is the difference between risks and issues? (Choose two).
option_1_content_en: A.Risks are uncertain and issues are certain.
option_2_content_en: B.Risks are certain and issues are uncertain.
option_3_content_en: C.Risks have occurred and issues may not occur.
option_4_content_en: D.Risks may not occur and an issue has occurred.

content_en: Which one of the following is not a Resource-Based Power in relation to mega projects?
option_1_content_en: A.Recruiting on a contractual basis
option_2_content_en: B.Recruiting expert talents
option_3_content_en: C.Recruitment on the basis of secondment
option_4_content_en: D.Recruitment via Direct Control

content_en: A project manager in an organization is considering implementing an agile project delivery. The organization has a strong project management office (PMO) and a well-defined change control process. What key aspect of agile project delivery should the project manager emphasize as the most compelling argument for its adoption?
option_1_content_en: A.Agile delivery can improve quality through incremental delivery and efficient defect repair.
option_2_content_en: B.Agile teams offer flexibility in accommodating planned changes while streamlining the approval process.
option_3_content_en: C.The product owner utilizes a list known as the backlog to prioritize work items, including planned changes.
option_4_content_en: D.Agile delivery is well-suited for handling unforeseen changes and shifting business expectations.

content_en: A project manager is assigned to a very complex and technical project. The project manager is currently working on the resources plan, and intends to recommend to the project sponsor that external resources should be used instead. What risks can be mitigated using one or more vendors to deliver components of the project? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.Financial
option_2_content_en: B.Schedule
option_3_content_en: C.Technical
option_4_content_en: D.Political

content_en: What tool should a project manager incorporate to better identify and respond to common stakeholder resistance to change challenges?
option_1_content_en: A.Change management
option_2_content_en: B.Risk management
option_3_content_en: C.Stakeholder management
option_4_content_en: D.Communication management

content_en: There is a variety of communication styles along a continuum that includes passive at one end – expressive in the middle – aggressive at the other end. As a project manager, which is the best style for success in communications with stakeholders?
option_1_content_en: A.Passive
option_2_content_en: B.Aggressive
option_3_content_en: C.Passive-Aggressive
option_4_content_en: D.Expressive

content_en: An experienced project manager is managing a multi-million dollar agile project. The project manager communicates the ground rules to the team, but after 12 iterations, the project manager starts noticing that some team members are not following the ground rules. What should the project manager do first to ensure team adherence to the ground rules? What should the project manager do first to ensure team adherence to the ground rules?
option_1_content_en: A.Contact human resources to request a written warning letter be sent to team members not following the ground rules.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the functional manager to replace team members not following the ground rules.
option_3_content_en: C.Schedule a meeting with the project team to reinforce the ground rules.
option_4_content_en: D.Notify the project sponsor about this behavior and ask the sponsor to take disciplinary action.

content_en: A project manager is working with a Scrum team that is continually missing deadlines. The steering committee is concerned about the project as it is not clear that it will deliver the expected value. After some analysis, the project manager discovers there is a mismatch of competencies in one of the teams. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Accept the risk of the project missing deadlines due to the mismatch.
option_2_content_en: B.Provide appropriate training to compensate for the mismatch.
option_3_content_en: C.Update the project schedule to reflect the delay.
option_4_content_en: D.Emphasize to the teams the importance of meeting the agreed deadlines.

content_en: A team has been working for two months and has consistently missed planned user stories. How should the project manager address this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Promote changing the iteration duration in order to commit as planned.
option_2_content_en: B.Ensure the sprint size is appropriate for the iteration duration.
option_3_content_en: C.Engage in recruiting a highly skilled resource to reinforce the skills.
option_4_content_en: D.Consider using a reward system to encourage timely delivery.

content_en: A project manager is managing a project with a hybrid approach and has requested a senior team member to perform a quantitative risk analysis. The team member responds that they do not have the knowledge to perform such an analysis. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Escalate the issue to the functional manager.
option_2_content_en: B.Contact the project management office (PMO) and request them to assign another team member who has the knowledge to perform this task to the team.
option_3_content_en: C.Help the team member to perform the quantitative risk analysis through coaching, mentoring, and training.
option_4_content_en: D.Perform the quantitative risk analysis for the team member.

content_en: A new warehouse facility is under construction. The project manager implements team development efforts such as training that will result in a lower defect ratio. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Introduce a training program.
option_2_content_en: B.Update the resource management plan.
option_3_content_en: C.Increase quality control reviews.
option_4_content_en: D.Add training costs to the budget.

content_en: A project manager is creating a software project's quality management plan. While reviewing lessons learned from past, similar projects, the project manager discovers that rework due to quality issues resulted in cost overruns. What should the project manager do to ensure that quality is addressed throughout the software development life cycle?
option_1_content_en: A.Conduct recurring retrospectives to regularly check on the effectiveness of quality processes.
option_2_content_en: B.Assign a resource to focus solely on the project’s quality.
option_3_content_en: C.Ensure that quality is tied to performance reviews.
option_4_content_en: D.Identify new quality policies and procedures for the project.

content_en: A newly-hired project manager is running a project for the first time and is worried about rising tensions. Project team members are arguing during an effort-intensive phase and stakeholders have voiced some doubts about the project's performance. In a discussion with a senior project manager, the new project manager admits that they have a fear of conflict and asks the senior project manager how they perceive conflict. How should the senior project manager respond?
option_1_content_en: A.Conflict in projects is inevitable - focus on managing it.
option_2_content_en: B.Conflict in projects is preventable - replan the mitigation.
option_3_content_en: C.Conflict in projects is disastrous - prepare a recovery plan.
option_4_content_en: D.Conflict in projects is healthy - refrain from interfering.

content_en: A new graduate recently joined a mature agile R&D team. A mentor, assigned to work with the graduate, is overwhelmed by the extra workload. Team performance and motivation are dropping. How can the project manager help with this situation?
option_1_content_en: A.Maintain a laissez-faire leadership style with the team, but use a transactional style to give firm guidance to the graduate.
option_2_content_en: B.Ask the mentor to use a collaborative servant leader approach to perform the usual duties along with the mentor role.
option_3_content_en: C.Cancel the mentor plan and focus on keeping the graduate motivated by learning through an intensive immersion.
option_4_content_en: D.Ask three more team members to share the mentor role in order to reduce the individual mentor workload by 75%.

content_en: A project team is faced with deciding on the next steps to take in order to address recently identified tasks schedule delays. The project manager expects team members to make the appropriate decisions for their respectively assigned tasks and proceed to implement them. Which type of leadership style is the project manager using in this instance?
option_1_content_en: A.Democratic
option_2_content_en: B.Autocratic
option_3_content_en: C.Free rein
option_4_content_en: D.Smoothing

content_en: A project team is in the process of identifying the benefits associated with two projects in order to choose the one that will deliver more business value. The task involves analyzing which project best helps the company meet its compliance and regulatory requirements, as well as improve customer satisfaction. Which of the following best describes the category of the benefits being analyzed in this task?
option_1_content_en: A.Quantitative benefit
option_2_content_en: B.Qualitative benefit
option_3_content_en: C.Quality benefit
option_4_content_en: D.Real benefit

content_en: A project is set to install three MRI units in a hospital; one unit has passed acceptance testing and two are under construction. The client requests a change order to add a fourth unit with slightly different requirements. What should the project manager do to accurately estimate the additional unit's delivery?
option_1_content_en: A.Rely on historical data from similar projects.
option_2_content_en: B.Break the work down into smaller tasks and estimate each individually.
option_3_content_en: C.Use industry formulas or models based on project characteristics.
option_4_content_en: D. Compare the new unit to the existing ones and adjust the existing estimates.

content_en: A project manager is leading a project team composed of members from different departments, including engineering, marketing, and sales. During the development process, a conflict arises between the engineering and marketing teams. The engineering team is focused on delivering the product on time and within budget, while the marketing team is focused on ensuring that the product meets the needs of the target market. What should the project manager do?
option_1_content_en: A.Suggest that the engineering and marketing teams each give up something to reach an agreement.
option_2_content_en: B.Suggest that the engineering and marketing teams work together to find a solution that works for both teams.
option_3_content_en: C.Suggest that the engineering team is correct and ensure that the product is delivered on time and within budget.
option_4_content_en: D.Suggest that the engineering and marketing teams compete to see who can come up with the best solution.

content_en: A project team is working on determining the dependencies for activities for an ongoing project. What action should the project team take first to manage dependencies successfully?
option_1_content_en: A.Monitor and track the dependencies.
option_2_content_en: B.Communicate the dependencies to the sponsor.
option_3_content_en: C.Assess and document the dependencies.
option_4_content_en: D.Appoint project schedulers for all tasks.

content_en: A project manager is in a successful automotive company with high quality standards. The project manager needs to ensure that they create a high-quality WBS. Which of the following is not a key characteristic of a high quality WBS?
option_1_content_en: A.Deliverable oriented
option_2_content_en: B.Hierarchical
option_3_content_en: C.The 100% rule
option_4_content_en: D.Customer focused

content_en: Which of the following project artifacts do not utilize the WBS as an input?
option_1_content_en: A.Project schedule
option_2_content_en: B.Project scope
option_3_content_en: C.Risk management plan
option_4_content_en: D.Quality plan

content_en: In a program, several groups are identifying problem solving techniques and each group presents a proposal. Among those listed, which is valid?
option_1_content_en: A.Performing project health checks
option_2_content_en: B.Reading literature related to your industry
option_3_content_en: C.Establishing a project suggestion box
option_4_content_en: D.All of the above

content_en: A project manager is leading a project with 34 team members from six countries. The scope of the project is to modernize a process used for almost 40 years in the organization. What criteria should the project manager consider while developing the communication plan? (Choose 3).
option_1_content_en: A.Personal diversity
option_2_content_en: B.Age diversity
option_3_content_en: C.Cultural diversity
option_4_content_en: D.Skill diversity

content_en: After consultation with executive stakeholders, it was decided that the project manager would replace a vendor while the project is in the execution phase. The new vendor simply has more domain knowledge and was not identified earlier, but is probably the right vendor candidate now. Which of the following documents would contain the best information for the new vendor?
option_1_content_en: A.Request for Information (RFI)
option_2_content_en: B.Request for Quote (RFQ)
option_3_content_en: C.Request for Proposal (RFP)
option_4_content_en: D.Request for Contract (RFC)

content_en: During the weekly meeting, team members are reviewing the tasks assigned by the Project Manager. A few team members are complaining that there is not enough information to estimate how long it will take to complete the work. What is the most likely cause for this issue?
option_1_content_en: A.Project objectives are not clearly defined
option_2_content_en: B.The business environment is very dynamic
option_3_content_en: C.Internal competition between team members
option_4_content_en: D.Roles & Responsibilities are not clearly defined

content_en: You are managing a complex project with a large number of stakeholders. You decided to use the Salience Model to identify and group the most important stakeholders based on their power, urgency and legitimacy. Which of the following aspects is the most important in this instance?
option_1_content_en: A.Dominant
option_2_content_en: B.Dependent
option_3_content_en: C.Demanding
option_4_content_en: D.Definitive

content_en: At the midway point of a project, the project manager was informed of a market movement that would make the project results useless to the client. This information could cause the project to be cancelled or at least a big change on the scope and desired outcome. What should the project manager do next?
option_1_content_en: A.Prepare all status reports and demos to keep the client focused on the project execution that has been successful.
option_2_content_en: B.Have a transparent discussion with the project sponsor, offering support on the strategy evaluation if needed.
option_3_content_en: C.Continue working on the project execution, as the business strategy is not responsibility of the project manager.
option_4_content_en: D.Halt the project immediately, as the project manager knows it will be useless to the client.

content_en: Which of the following is different to the other options for managing external stakeholders in mega projects?
option_1_content_en: A.Persuasion
option_2_content_en: B.Deputation
option_3_content_en: C.Give and take
option_4_content_en: D.Strict orders
